The court's decision enables the developer's claims to progress to judicial review, potentially influencing other property owners experiencing similar challenges.

This development is raising the bar for luxury living in India's housing sector.

title: Kentucky sinks 1,700 discarded Christmas trees in lake to shelter fish
description: Kentucky collected around 5,000 discarded Christmas trees in 2026 to restore underwater habitats in its ageing lakes. As part of the state's 'Christmas for the Fishes' programme, approximately 1,700 trees were submerged in Boltz Lake alone. The trees provide shelter and feeding areas for fish, replacing natural structures that have decayed over time. The initiative also helps improve recreational fishing opportunities.

The increase in profitability outpaced revenue growth. Apple's India net profit climbed 66% to Rs 5,311 crore in FY26, compared with Rs 3,196 crore a year earlier. In FY25, profit had grown by 16%.

After the traditional burning of Ravana's effigies, they conduct rituals honoring his legacy. This community perceives Ravana not only as an antagonist but as a learned king and musician. Their observances include bathing, changing sacred threads, and offering prayers at their temple.

This decision follows allegations of discrimination against qualified U.S. workers during its recruitment process. A fine of $1.4 million will be imposed to resolve the case and compensate affected workers. Additionally, the company will face compliance obligations to uphold federal labor laws. This settlement highlights ongoing efforts to protect U.S.

Local priest Ramesh Mishra continues a family tradition of worshiping this nine-headed idol on Dussehra. Unlike the common tradition of burning Ravana's effigy, this statue is revered and safeguarded. The region is also linked with local myths surrounding the Ramayana, adding cultural significance.

Following the incident, local police secured the rifle and reported the matter to their superiors.

Organisers explained that Mehndi had performed despite feeling unwell and was a last-minute replacement for another artist. On Wednesday, an appeals court ruled that the renovations did not establish a binding purchase agreement. However, the couple may still receive compensation for the improvements, while the homeowners can pursue eviction proceedings.
